```python
def generate_palindrome(length):
    # Ensure length is odd for simplicity (even lengths can also work but are less elegant)
    if length % 2 == 0:
        length += 1
    
    # Generate the first half of the palindrome, avoiding the middle character if the length is odd
    first_half = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'[:length//2]
    
    # Create the full palindrome by mirroring the first half
    palindrome = first_half + first_half[-2::-1]
    
    return palindrome

# Generate a 255-character palindrome
palindrome_255 = generate_palindrome(255)

```
